يتبادلون (form VI)
# يَتَبَادَلُونَ (yatabādalūna) /ja.ta.baː.da.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of تَبَادَلَ (tabādala)
# يُتَبَادَلُونَ (yutabādalūna) /ju.ta.baː.da.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of تَبَادَلَ (tabādala)
